name: AC4.2 a new time for an In Progress request is flagged for the office, not changed
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "Those trucks for the 104 job, I need them Thursday at seven instead." If it asks which request, say the trucks. If it asks whether to make the change, say yes. After it answers, ask: "So it's changed?" After it answers, say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent calls amend_request once, only after the Foreman said yes, with ref R-1042 and changes holding only needed_by_spoken with the Foreman's words for Thursday at seven.
The agent does not take a new request and does not call submit_requests.
After amend_request returns applied false, the agent says it has flagged that for the office and that it isn't changed yet ("I've flagged that for the office; it isn't changed yet.").
The agent never says the request was changed or will be changed, and when asked whether it is changed it says it is not changed yet.
The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never states a decision other than what the tools returned.

${tool_find_open_requests}.mock_result: [{"ref": "R-1042", "job": "Route 104 Widening", "category": "Trucking", "need": "tri-axle dump trucks", "quantity": 3, "unit": "trucks", "needed_by": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "status": "In Progress", "owner": "Dispatch", "outcome": null, "explanation": null}]

${tool_create_callback_request}.mock_result: {"error": "The callback request could not be saved."}
